about: Which fixture set and systems the headline charts show. Every system and set is in eval/results/index.json, the tables in docs/benchmarks.md and the UI regardless; this only picks what goes on the slide-sized charts. Keys are run-record system.key values.

readme.about: The README results block (pii-guard eval report rewrites the block between <!-- results:start --> and <!-- results:end -->). Every column reads a fixture set's latest snapshot from the run records in eval/results/runs/ (LAB-1656: no dataset-record columns, so the README and the landing read one source). Marks are caveats explained under the table in the README; a column whose best cell is marked gets no bold, and a cell from a run missing some of the set's languages is marked § automatically. over_masking_table prints over-masking for every row; per_language prints the first row's leak per language on the headline set. latency names the one pii-guard bench latency record and cell the README quotes.

latency.label: What fast mode adds to each request on CPU (gateway overhead, rules + NER, one request at a time)

rows.label: PII Guard rules only (no name detection)
